items.title: 67250_John Collins oral history interview
items.q: we went to Mexico, it was Nancy, Phil Wright, a conductor, pianist, and Harol Howard Jones the drummer who was with Basie, and our bass player was -- I forget his name.

ctx.x: recorded with Ramsey Lewis out here, and I think on this date it was Ramsey Lewis and Eddie Harris, the saxophone player. It was a very good date. And I have done so many recordings with Nancy Wilson, you know, I've just -- I was on her television show. She just stopped recently because she's pregnant. She's expecting now. And I think she' going to have another show when she's ready, you know, and everything is over.

And let's see, oh, I just came by -- I went to Mexico with Nancy I think I told you. Well, we went to Mexico, it was Nancy, Phil Wright, a conductor, pianist, and Harol Howard Jones the drummer who was with Basie, and our bass player was -- I forget his name. Any way, we went to Mexico to play a private party for this Mexican guy who had about 20 friends. So they -- they picked up all expenses, hotels, food, everything, and they brought in nine models from Nieman Marcus to model for them, and in his living, it's…
